Cannot go to another map now.
The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
You must be [Outsiders].\nSo, the fortress must be near here, right?
[Outsiders]? What do you mean?\nWell, Ethos Fortress is still far from here.
Dad, I can't walk any more…
I can't either…
It's dangerous to stay here.\nStand up. We must go.
Hey, which faction do you belong to?\nI haven't really seen your clothes.
Faction? There's no faction for us.\nWe are Albatif.\nWe live in this area with Yelb the Grass Dragon.
Oh, I see. \nSo, they're ethnic minority people.
...Some tribes don't belong to a faction.\nThey have their own distinctive way of living and\nthey don't interact with other tribes…
So, you are going out of your hometown, right?\nBut why?
We are facing danger...\nWe've been attacked by the monsters coming from\nthe gate that appeared near our village...
Our village was burned down and many people were\ntaken by them...
...Yelb the Grass Dragon tried hard to protect us.\nBut...
These days, the evil energy leaking out from the\nstrange gate is withering Yelb's body and\ngradually affecting the dragon's mind...
As a result, Yelb became out of control and\nbegan to go on a rampage...
Aww…
Yelb said...[Run before I'm completely\ncontrolled by the evil energy.]
We managed to escape this far but...\nI'm worried about the people and Yelb...
We're going there, right?\nJust say yes and relieve him. Huh? Of course!\nThe village is on our way, so we can stop by!
...Me?\nI'm prepared.\nI've gotta make up for picking the gem.
No worries!\nWe're going to the Gate of Another World.\nI mean the strange gate.
We'll beat the evil down and save the people,\nyour hometown and the dragon called Yelb!!
Really?!
Can we go home?
Leave it to us!!\nSo, just walk a little more with your dad and\nwait in a safe place...
Ethos Fortress is beyond the place called Fabizo.\nI know it's hard to travel with children but...\nBe careful of the monsters.
I got it.\nI'll leave the village and Yelb to you.\nThanks.
